nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore file excluding compiled objects (*.o, *.obj, /obj), precompiled headers (*.gch, *.pch), libraries (*.so, *.dylib, *.a), and executables (*.exe, *.bin, *.iso) from version control.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG
nodes.summary: Project changelog documenting versions v1.0 to v1.3 with features: read long file, FAT filesystem B02, filesystem B01, and HTTP server fix.

nodes.name: linker.ld
nodes.summary: GNU ld linker script for i386 ELF format. Entry point is 'loader'. Sections: .text (0x0100000, includes .multiboot, .text, .rodata), .data (with init_array constructors), .bss. Discards .fini_array and .comment.

nodes.name: makefile
nodes.summary: Build system for the x86OS kernel. Compiles C++ with GCC (m32, nostdlib, no-exceptions/rtti), assembles .s files, links with ld. Builds a GRUB-bootable ISO via grub-mkrescue. Targets: run (VirtualBox), install (copy to /boot), clean.
